posts.text: Mike McCarthy on the challenges the Defensive Coordinator for the Colts present: “He's done it for a long time, so he's very well-rehearsed. Clearly, on special teams, he's been a standout player for us.And even in the Cleveland game, when he got the opportunity to go in there, he was extremely productive.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy gives an update on Jamel Dean: “Yeah, we'll see. I know he was feeling better on Monday than we expected, so we'll see where he is.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy on working with the new guys the Steelers brought in: “The new guys really have only had one day. We were actually talking about the roster right before I came out here. The biggest thing is having a plan for those guys and making sure they're getting work so we can evaluate them. We have a full week to see how things play out for the Colts game. Like all of our players dealing with injuries, they're working through it, so we'll see how that goes. But I've really only had one day with them, and most of my impressions are based on conversations. We're glad they're here, but as far as how much we'll use them, that will be determined by the end of the week.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy details their third-down issues: “I think it's execution. If you execute well enough on first and second down, you put yourself in those positions. But that's the first step. The first step is creating the opportunities to be in those situations. Our numbers are really good on third-and-2, third-and-3, third-and-4, third-and-5, and third-and-6. But yes, we clearly have to be better in that area.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy on Roman Wilson’s Growth: “Roman has a second gear that you love to utilize as much as possible. I think the discipline of route running is a big part of it. Obviously, you have the releases and the discipline that comes with those, but it's also about really understanding the stem, resetting the stem, and having the patience and discipline to fully get to the breaking point. You don't want to feel like you have to hit that second gear all the time because his ability to separate is top-notch. I think he's learning the discipline required in the different parts of each route, and he's definitely improving.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy explains why Aaron Rodgers has been sacked 13 times (most in the NFL): “Well, you've kind of answered the question there. It's a combination of reasons. I think having the opportunity to go through the specifics of everything, that's what we focus on. When you throw the ball, you have to have a philosophy of protection first and how you approach it. This game will probably be a little different just because of the weather we're getting ready to deal with. But that's all part of why you take the time to go through the self-scout. There are a number of things we can be better at.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy on what his plan are when Rico Dowdle gets healthy: “I think the biggest thing is that we're getting ready to play the Colts, and obviously Jalen is a big part of that game plan. I'm not really sure where Rico is as far as coming back.But to sit here and talk about snaps a week or two down the line, I really don't have an answer for you.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy was asked if he had a plan or vision for how he would get enough snaps for their big contract guys like Darnell, Herbig: “Well, first of all, I think when a player achieves a second contract, he's earned that. Those men put themselves in that position prior to me arriving here. But yes, when you're building your offensive menu and putting your system together, you're obviously looking at the veterans you have. With that being said, that's why some of those packages are in place and why they're prioritized. We've played about 25% of our season, and I've been trying to utilize them. But yes, those guys were definitely part of our offseason conversations.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Greg Cosell on the Ross Tucker Podcast feels Jaylen Warren is the Steelers best player on offense: “You know, when I watch the Steelers, I always come away feeling that Jalen Warren is their best player on offense. That's the way I feel. When I watch him, I feel like he can become a feature back, a guy you can give the ball to 20 times a game. I think they're still working through the changes they made on the right side of their offensive line, but they're going to have to be a run-first team. With Aaron Rodgers, people probably think, 'Oh, everything is about Aaron Rodgers.' But when I watch their tape and the way they play, I think that offense has to run through Jalen Warren.” #Steelers #NFL https://x.com/RossTuckerPod/status/2108195720658665960/video/1

posts.text: NFL Week 4 fantasy football injury report, weather forecast and streaming opportunities - The New York Times

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is believed to be day-to-day with his ankle injury, one that will be monitored and treated this coming week.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens CB Marlon Humphrey (calf) has been ruled out.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is questionable to return.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Marcus Mariota aggravated his MCL injury and now will have tests, per Molly McGrath. Expect him to miss some time.

That said, there is hope that QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) is back next week.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota is officially questionable with a knee injury. Athan Kaliakmanis in at QB.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Steelers DT Derrick Harmon, who was carted off on Thursday night with a foot injury, is expected to miss a few weeks, source said.

IR would be a consideration for Harmon, though it’s not definite. Either way, not a long-term injury.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Panthers OT Monroe Freeling, who was in the NFL’s concussion protocol, has cleared and will play today against the Lions.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers, who was limited this week with a hamstring injury, is expected to play today, source said. He was questionable.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Texans veteran edge Jadeveon Clowney, questionable with a knee, is expected back on the field today, source said. He hasn’t played since the opener.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is likely to play today after battling a foot injury all week, source said. McConkey recently fought through a rib injury, and this is not considered as serious.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans was able to practice late this week despite a rib injury and said he’ll do his best to be out there. The team has expressed optimism, though as George Kittle noted, “Fractured ribs suck.”

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Commanders star WR Terry McLaurin is officially out for today’s game in London against the Colts. He suffered a hamstring injury late this week in practice

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: TItans RB Tyjae Spears, dealing with an ankle injury and questionable, is expected to play today.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six regular-season games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy, the NFL announced today.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Patriots will play the Bills on Sunday without standout defenders CB Christian Gonzalez and DT Christian Barmore, who have both been ruled out.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: NFL Week 4 injury report: Player statuses for all 16 games - NFL.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The 49ers are signing veteran DT Naquan Jones off the Vikings practice squad, per source.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Commanders have officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with a left elbow injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty believed to have sprained ankle - NFL.com

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: #Bears GM Ryan Poles, via team statement: “This morning, after meeting with George and Kevin, we informed Matt of our decision to move in a different direction with the leadership of our football team and the head coaching position…”

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: Will this game be over before I have to leave for Cincinnati on Saturday 🫠

posts.author: jglazer.bsky.social
posts.text: Ok, finally dipping my toe in these waters. I realllllly hope this is way less of a negative cesspool than X!

irregularities.detail: Probe of https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.searchPosts?q=nfl%20injury&limit=1&sort=latest returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Forbidden). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. app.bsky.feed.searchPosts is HTTP 403 for this project (re-measured 2026-09-18 from the CI runner and from an independent client IP). Unauthenticated Bluesky search is therefore unavailable; discovery comes from Google News and from the verified handles this project follows directly (app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, which does work).

irregularities.detail: Probe of https://www.reddit.com/r/NFL_Discussion/about.json?raw_json=1 returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Blocked). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. Reddit's public JSON endpoints have contested availability in 2026 (some reports say ~60 req/min unauthenticated, others say broadly blocked with 403 since May 2026), so an unreachable probe here is expected and is not treated as a pipeline failure.
